title: Sharp Sell-Off On D-Street; Nifty Opens Below 22,300, Sensex Falls 1,400 Points
text: Sharp Sell-Off On D-Street; Nifty Opens Below 22,300, Sensex Falls 1,400 PointsDespite mixed global cues, the Indian indices opened lower on April 2 with Nifty below 22,300. The Sensex was down 1,314.02 points or 1.80 percent at 71,820.30, and the Nifty was down 399.35 points or 1.76 percent at 22,280.05. About 559 shares advanced, 1914 shares declined, and 128 shares unchanged.
